sms.title: Remove the SMS provider?
sms.body: Member texts stop: booking and billing notices, announcements and texted links aren't sent until you connect a provider again.
sms.secret: The stored credentials are deleted and can't be shown again. To undo this, enter them again.
email.title: Remove your gym's email settings?
email.install: Emails will be sent with this install's settings instead.
email.none: Your gym will send no email until you enter email settings again.
email.secret: The stored password is deleted and can't be shown again. To undo this, enter the settings again.
